column1: # the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: a 9 GB block with a 8.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself.
# Snowdrop's page allocator reserved 12 GB there; patches.py cuts it to 4 GB, and sdk_patches.py the SDK's 1 GB node area to 64 MB (README.md, Memory)

# Android needs the larger alias: ~1 GB is already used before the game's allocator runs, so the 4 GB reservation does not fit in 4.375 GB and AllocateAddressRegion fails (base 0), crashing in DT_INIT (README.md, Memory).
# the shaders are GLSLC outputs in the shader cache files (camel/shadercache/nx/*.mcache), bare zlib streams in the SDF data slices (shader_split.py snowdrop_zlib)
